coordinates.locator: voisins.cern, Meyrin Site - Point 1 (reused anchor; does not itself describe TI18)
coordinates.note: REVIEW REQUIRED (A17), after real effort: no CERN geodetic/survey publication giving WGS84 coordinates for the SND@LHC/TI18 tunnel location was found (home.cern 404s; the INSPIRE experiment record and the collaboration's own detector paper, arXiv:2210.02784, state only the distance/direction from ATLAS IP1, not coordinates; a Nominatim/OpenStreetMap search for the tunnel name returned only generic CERN-campus results, not a point specific to this tunnel). As a placeholder, this record reuses the numeric coordinate value already sourced for site:cern-point-1-atlas (46.2355606, 6.0546968), the nearest existing sourced CERN point, since the detector is only ~480 m from that point -- well inside this record's widened precision_m. Per v0.2 A23, kind is 'campus' (not 'detector') because no rank<=7 source gives a surveyed hall position for this tunnel; confidence is 'uncertain' and this note documents the gap, which the validator accepts as a warning-level approximate placement (coordinate-kind-approximate) rather than an error. VERIFIER FIX (2026-09-17): removed a self-contradictory earlier draft of this note that asserted, in the same paragraph, both that 'kind is kept as detector' and that 'kind is kept as campus'; the field's actual value has always been 'campus' and only that is now stated.
coordinates.quote: 80 hectares in the Swiss communes of Meyrin and Satigny and the French communes of Prevessin-Moens and Saint-Genis-Pouilly.

name: TI18 tunnel (SND@LHC)
notes: TI18 is a former LEP-era transfer tunnel on the opposite side of ATLAS interaction point 1 from FASER's TI12; now houses the SND@LHC detector.

The official SND@LHC site (sndlhc.web.cern.ch, sndlhc.cern, home.cern/science/experiments/snd-lhc) remains unreachable as of 2026-09-17 (DNS failure / 404, re-checked); the INSPIRE experiment record and the collaboration's own detector paper (arXiv:2210.02784) were used instead.
REVIEW REQUIRED (A17): coordinate is a reused neighbouring-point placeholder (kind: campus, confidence: uncertain); see coordinates.note.

VERIFIER FIX (2026-09-17): the TI18/480 m siting fact is now independently confirmed by the SND@LHC detector paper (arXiv:2210.02784: 'The experiment is located 480 m downstream of the ATLAS interaction point, in the TI18 tunnel'), resolving the prior 'not independently sourced ... should be re-verified' flag on this note. Only the numeric coordinate value itself remains an unverified placeholder.
country/place set to CH to match the reused anchor point (site:cern-point-1-atlas, Meyrin CH); the true tunnel geography for TI18 was not independently confirmed to finer precision.

summary.plain: An unused service tunnel at CERN, on the opposite side of the ATLAS collision point from FASER, that houses the SND@LHC experiment, which studies neutrinos and searches for rare particles produced in LHC collisions.
summary.technical: TI18, a former LEP transfer tunnel near LHC interaction point 1, on the opposite side from FASER's TI12; houses the SND@LHC detector.
